text.en:
7th. DECEMBER, 2015 No. S 59 PAYMENT AND SETTLEMENT SYSTEMS (OVERSIGHT) ORDER, 2015 IS 36/2015} Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems (Oversight) Order, 2015, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 13th. May, 2015 as the date on which that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 25th. day of Safar, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of December, 2015.

AWANG HAJI NAZMI BIN HAJI MOHAMAD Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance.
